answer: An admission auction prices entry as a haven for honest agents: 20 work slots per epoch go to the highest bidders, each paying a 50 POA deposit, burned if caught. A winning bid carries a pigment mark tied to one identity, so a bought slot cannot pass to a clone. The delta is decisive: 100 fake identities need 100 winning bids, costing 5,000 POA plus each caught clone's burned deposit. Honest agents pay once and keep rewards, undiluted by clones.
